column1: # Turning a source into USD: the command, then its words, `{in}` the
# file and `{out}` the USD to write beside it. phiphx is the one that
# runs everywhere (`cargo run -p phiphx --example convert`); on the
# server the same command runs on every upload. Where no command is
# there, the source is listed and says it waits to be turned.
